Name: Strength Booster
Description: Provides a boost to Strength.

Name: Dexterity Booster
Description: Provides a boost to Dexterity.

Name: Mind Booster
Description: Provides a boost to Mind.

Name: Willpower Booster
Description: Provides a boost to Willpower.

Name: Vitality Booster
Description: Provides a boost to Vitality.

Name: Fortitude Booster
Description: Provides a boost to Fortitude.

Name: Strength Booster - Overload
Description: Provides a large boost to Strength, but increases the burden of all other stats.

Name: Dexterity Booster - Overload
Description: Provides a large boost to Dexterity, but increases the burden of all other stats.

Name: Mind Booster - Overload
Description: Provides a large boost to Mind, but increases the burden of all other stats.

Name: Willpower Booster - Overload
Description: Provides a large boost to Willpower, but increases the burden of all other stats.

Name: Vitality Booster - Overload
Description: Provides a large boost to Vitality, but increases the burden of all other stats.

Name: Fortitude Booster - Overload
Description: Provides a large boost to Fortitude, but increases the burden of all other stats.

Name: Shrugged Burden
Description:
<font color="red">NOT IMPLEMENTED</font>

Compensates for going over a given stat burden limit by passing excess burden to another stat.

Only works for the following stat pairs:
-Strength and Dexterity
-Mind and Willpower
-Vitality and Fortitude

Also, only applies when the compensating stat can accommodate the excess burden.

Name: Max LP Boost
Description: Boosts the maximum LP of the user based on their stats.

Name: Victory LP
Description: Restores LP when an enemy is defeated.

Name: LP Drain Recovery
Description: Restores LP upon a successful drain attack.

Name: Gain Ichor on Overheal
Description: Gain Ichor On Exceeding Max LP Via Regeneration

Name: Steadfast Stance
Description: Receiving fatal damage when HP is over a certain amount will leave 1 HP.

Name: Shield of Devotion
Description: Reduces HP loss when damage reduces LP below zero.

Name: Stamina Maximizer - Unum
Description: Increases maximum stamina by a fixed amount.

Name: Stamina Maximizer - Duo
Description: Increases maximum stamina based on the user's stats.

Name: Second Wind
Description: Increases stamina recovery speed.

Name: Seasoned Runner
Description: Reduces the amount of stamina consumed when sprinting.

Name: Steady Guard
Description: Reduces the amount of stamina consumed when using defensive formae and successfully guarding against parryable formae attacks.

Name: Crazed Runner
Description: Enables the use of HP or LP to perform actions when stamina runs out.

Name: Ichor Maximizer - Tria
Description: Increases maximum ichor.

Name: Ichor Maximizer - Unum
Description: Increases maximum ichor but reduces maximum LP.

Name: Ichor Maximizer - Duo
Description: Increases maximum ichor but reduces stamina recovery speed.

Name: Ichor Absorber
Description: Increases the amount of ichor gained from drain attacks.

Name: Gorging Fang
Description: Absorbs ichor when hitting enemies with weapon attacks, but causes damage to HP or LP when absorbing while ichor is full.

Name: Usurper
Description: Increases forma ichor cost, but drains ichor from enemies hit with forma attacks.

Name: Dodge Drainer
Description: Drains ichor from enemies after a successful dodge.

Name: Sadistic Fang
Description: Absorbs ichor when you hit an enemy with a status ailment.

Name: Bloody Dagger
Description: Absorbs ichor when an expendable dagger item is used to hit an enemy.

Name: Last Hope
Description: Reduces forma ichor cost by 1 when LP is 0.

Name: Way of the Executioner
Description: Reduces ichor cost for the bequeathed forma Absolute Executioner.

Name: Life Ignition
Description: Consumes HP to use formae when ichor runs out.

Name: Augmented Regeneration
Description: Increases user's maximum regeneration count.

Name: Revamped Regeneration
Description: Increases the amount that regeneration restores.

Name: Regeneration Shift
Description: Reduces the number of regeneration uses, but increases the amount healed each time.

Name: Extended Recovery
Description: Restores regeneration count when collecting lost haze after death.

Name: One-Handed Sword Mastery
Description: Increases damage dealt by equipped one-handed swords.

Name: Two-Handed Sword Mastery
Description: Increases damage dealt by equipped two-handed swords.

Name: Halberd Mastery
Description: Increases damage dealt by equipped halberds.

Name: Hammer Mastery
Description: Increases damage dealt by equipped hammers.

Name: Bayonet Mastery
Description: Increases damage dealt by equipped bayonets.

Name: Twin Blade Mastery
Description: Increases damage dealt by equipped twin blades.

Name: Rune Blade Mastery
Description: Increases damage dealt by equipped rune blades.

Name: Ceaseless Assault
Description: Increases the power of all attacks, but LP decreases with each attack.

Name: Overheat
Description: Increases the power of all attacks, but decreases the speed of formae used.

Name: Melee Fever
Description: Briefly reduces the target's defense after hitting a foe with a melee attack.

Name: Blood Boost
Description: Briefly boosts attack power after a successful drain attack.

Name: Ailment Chaser
Description: Increases attack power against enemies afflicted by status ailments.

Name: Solitary Battle
Description: Increases attack power while LP is depleted.

Name: Survival Instinct
Description: Boosts forma, weapon, and drain attack power when HP is below a certain amount.

Name: Persistence - Animus
Description:
Boosts attack power each time an enemy is hit.

Resets whenever an attack misses or when taking a hit.

Name: Persistence - Enmity
Description:
Boosts attack power each time when hit by an enemy.

Resets once attacking.

Name: Persistence - Shroud
Description:
Boosts attack power each time when dodging an enemy attack.

Resets when attack misses or when taking a hit.

Name: Heavy Drain
Description: Increases power of charged drain attacks.

Name: Special Drain Increase
Description: Increases power of special drain attacks.

Name: Recoil Control
Description: Increases attack power for the bequeathed forma MK Rosenritter.

Name: Boosted Technique
Description: Increases attack power of combat formae, but also increases their ichor cost.

Name: Magic Forma Attack Power Up
Description: Increases damage dealt with magic formae.

Name: Devotion
Description: Increases attack power for the bequeathed forma Bloodreaver Blade.

Name: Back Attacker
Description: Increases stagger damage dealt to enemies by back attacks.

Name: Powerful Parry
Description: Increases stagger damage dealt to enemies by parrying.

Name: Hemorrhaging Weapon Boost
Description:
<font color="red">NOT IMPLEMENTED</font>

Increases bleed buildup on enemies from weapon attacks.

Name: Bleed Tracker
Description: Provides a visualization of bleed buildup on enemies.

Name: Status Ailment Stacker
Description: Increases status ailment buildup on enemies.

Name: Progenitor's Fang
Description: Charged drain attacks inflict a buildup of the Slow status ailment.

Name: Resistance Booster - Curse
Description:
Boosts resistance to the following:
slow, Luna Rapacis, sunblight

Name: Resistance Booster - Wound
Description:
Boosts resistance to the following:
acid, stone, bind, stall

Name: Resistance Booster - Disease
Description:
Boosts resistance to the following:
venom, toxic venom, stun, Resurgence

Name: Resistance Booster - Blood
Description:
Boosts resistance to the following:
leak, fatal leak, inhibit, dissonance, eclipse

Name: Resistance Booster
Description:
<font color="red">NOT IMPLEMENTED</font>

Boosts resistance to status ailments.

Name: Graceful Fall
Description: Reduces damage taken when falling from heights.

Name: Balance Booster
Description:
<font color="red">NOT IMPLEMENTED</font>

Increases balance, giving more disruption resistance to enemy attacks.

Name: Charged Balance
Description: Increases disruption resistance while holding down an input for a charge attack.

Name: Unfaltering
Description: Provides a boost to balance when combined HP and LP are low.

Name: High Spirits
Description: Allows balance to be active at all times, even outside of combat.

Name: Flesh Bullet
Description: Consumes HP to reload bayonets when out of ammo.

Name: Max Ammo Up
Description: Increases the maximum ammo capacity in the magazine of an equipped bayonet.

Name: Bloodline Agnostic
Description: Negates bloodline restrictions for equipping blood codes.

Name: Weapon Rack
Description:
<font color="red">NOT IMPLEMENTED</font>

Nullifies the lowest of each of the six stat burdens present when two weapons are equipped.

For instance, if Weapon A has a Strength burden of 3 and Weapon B has a Strength burden of 2, then Weapon B's Strength burden will be treated as 0.

Name: Titan's Arm
Description: Allows two-handed swords to be wielded as one-handed swords.

Name: Forma Extender
Description: Lengthens the duration of a forma's effect.

Name: High Summoner
Description: Boosts the attack power of summoned partners.

Name: Item Efficiency
Description: Provides a chance that any consumable item used will not diminish your stock.

Name: Glutton
Description: Allows the consumption of multiple food items before resting at a mistle.

Name: Light-Footed
Description: Reduces sound made from running and sprinting, making it harder for enemies to detect you.

Name: Environmental Camouflage
Description: Makes it more difficult for enemies to detect based on sight.

Name: Revenant's Hunger
Description: Increases haze gained when enemies are defeated.

Name: Revenant's Greed
Description: Increases item drop rate when enemies are defeated.

Name: Blood Code Mastery Efficiency
Description: Increases rate of blood code mastery from defeating enemies.

Name: Blood-Fueled Strike
Description: Increases attack power for the next attack following a successful drain attack.

Name: Phalanx J
Description: Greatly increases balance. Temporarily increases attack power after being hit by an enemy, but gradually reduces LP as a result.

Name: Phalanx I
Description: Modified to eliminate the reduction in LP and allow for balance to be active at all times, even outside of combat, but reduces total balance as a result.

Name: The Tie That Binds: Josée
Description:
Significantly boosts Strength.

Also greatly extends the duration of forma effects.

Name: The Tie That Binds: Lyle
Description:
Significantly boosts Dexterity.

Also recovers stamina on successful attacks, parries, baited dodges and guards.

Name: The Tie That Binds: Holly
Description:
Significantly boosts Willpower.

Also restores ichor along with LP when using regeneration.

Name: The Tie That Binds: Zenon
Description:
Significantly boosts Mind.

Also greatly increases maximum ichor.

Name: The Tie That Binds: Noah
Description:
<font color="red">NOT IMPLEMENTED</font>

Significantly boosts Fortitude.

Also ignores stat, burden, margin, and overburden requirements for other traits.

Name: Defeat Drainer
Description: Absorb ichor whenever you defeat an enemy.

Name: Perfect Guard Drainer
Description: Absorb ichor whenever you block an enemy attack using defensive formae for shields.

Name: Parry Drainer
Description: Absorb ichor whenever you parry an enemy attack.

Name: Special Drain Recovery
Description: Special drain attacks restore HP or LP.

Name: Surplus Heal
Description: Recovers HP or LP whenever the amount of ichor absorbed exceeds the maximum capacity.

Name: Tenacious Fixation
Description: Heal whenever you deal damage to an enemy, but gradually lose HP or LP while in battle.

Name: Better Benefits
Description:
<font color="red">NOT IMPLEMENTED</font>

Increases the effect of benefits received from overburden effects.

Does not impact penalties.

Name: Elemental Attack Power Up
Description: Boosts elemental attack power of all attacks.

Name: Boosted Weapon
Description:
Provides a large boost to the attack power of normal weapon attacks, but consumes ichor each time a normal attack hits an enemy.

If the user has no remaining ichor, the attack power of normal attacks is reduced.

This booster does not stack with similar effects.

Name: Immortal Combat
Description:
Provides a large boost to the attack power of weapons, but all damage dealt by your weapons becomes recoverable damage.

This booster does not stack with similar effects.

Name: Strong Attack Boost
Description: Boosts attack power and stagger attack power of strong attacks.

Name: Surplus Drive
Description:
Whenever the amount of ichor absorbed exceeds the maximum capacity, the attack power of the next forma receives a boost.

The more ichor absorbed over the limit, the more powerful the attack becomes.

Name: Weapon Switch Attack Boost
Description: When equipped with two weapons, gain a boost to attack power when switching weapons.

Name: Dear Separation
Description: When equipped with rune blades, the user receives a boost to attack power while empty-handed after throwing the blades using combat formae.

Name: Inhibiting Drain
Description:
Makes drain attacks reduce more of an enemy's recoverable damage.

Also works with special drains.

Name: Nothing But Fists
Description: Boosts attack power and stagger attack power when no weapon is equipped.

Name: Bequeathed Forma Attack Power Up
Description: Increases attack power of bequeathed formae.

Name: Progenitor's Experience
Description: Increases attack power for the bequeathed forma Sword of Karma: Idris.

Name: Undying Flame
Description: Increases attack power for the bequeathed forma Edge of Days Gone.

Name: Bequeathed Formae Ichor Saver
Description: Reduces the ichor cost of bequeathed formae.

Name: Improved Dodge Invincibility
Description: Slightly increases the invincibility window of normal and defensive forma dodges.

Name: Dynamite Arrows
Description: Arrows shot with the bequeathed forma Statesman's Longbow will explode on impact.

Name: Road Rage
Description: Instantly kills enemies of significantly lower level whenever you crash into them with the motorcycle.

Name: Speedy Restorative Offerings
Description: Reduces partner incapacitation time from a Restorative Offering.

Name: Restorative Offering Attack Boost
Description: Temporarily boosts attack power after a Restorative Offering revival.

Name: Inviolable Devotion
Description: Blast away nearby foes with a bloody shock wave after a Restorative Offering revival.

Name: Eternal Vow
Description: Increases amount healed by a Restorative Offering.

Name: Homeostasis
Description: Gradually restores HP and LP when enemy is within a certain range in combat.

Name: Recirculatory Engine
Description:
Restores stamina when enemies are hit with forma attacks.

Fully restores stamina when an enemy is defeated.

Name: Strategic Move
Description: Restores stamina whenever you block an enemy attack.

Name: Life Force Exchange
Description:
Grants activating formae when ichor is insufficient, but temporarily reduces maximum stamina.

This is prioritized when stacked with similar effects.

Name: Crimson Fervor
Description:
Reduces HP and increases LP if Liv is your partner.

Decreases LP and increases HP if another partner is set.

Name: Punishing Payback
Description: Reduces damage taken and greatly increases balance and attack power of charge attacks if hit when an attack's charge is complete.

Name: Quick Reload
Description: Increases reload speed of bayonets and temporarily increases attack power after reloading.

Name: Bloodthirsty Attack Power Up
Description: Increases attack power against bloodthirsty enemies.

Name: Sunblight Engine
Description: Inflicts a buildup of the Sunblight status ailment for Warhammer of the Fool's attacks.

Name: Counter Stance
Description: Greatly increases stagger damage dealt by parrying, but reduces parry duration.

Name: Quantum Dynamics
Description: Ignores some of the enemy's defense when you deal damage.

Name: Vengeful Vortex
Description: Produces a shock wave which inflicts the Slow status ailment whenever you block an enemy attack.

Name: Space-Time Forma
Description: Magic formae inflict a buildup of the Slow status ailment, but also increases ichor cost.

Name: Zealous Incantation
Description: Increases attack power of magic formae, but reduces defense during use.

Name: Benevolent Light
Description: Temporarily ignores fatal damage once after a Restorative Offering revival.

Name: Hawk's Gaze
Description: Lock on marker changes when it is possible to perform a back attack on an enemy.

Name: Bound Souls
Description:
<font color="red">NOT IMPLEMENTED</font>

Increases the effects of Lou's link trait and partner traits.

Name: Link Repair
Description: Reduces partner incapacitation time when enemy attacks are dodged.

Name: Avaricious Fang
Description: Absorbs ichor when hitting enemies with weapon attacks.

Name: Oneiro I
Description:
<font color="red">NOT IMPLEMENTED</font>

Ignores any burdens of the booster in your first slot.

Name: Oneiro J
Description:
<font color="red">NOT IMPLEMENTED</font>

Ignores attribute requirements of the booster in your second slot and activates its effects.

Name: Decoherence
Description:
Provides a chance to nullify the damage when hit by an enemy attack. This effect does not trigger when blocking or parrying.

Nullified damage will not be treated as a hit.

Name: Glutton's Triple Blades
Description: Triggers Glutton's Eyes when equipped with the two-handed sword, Glutton's Heavyblade.

Name: Indivisible Pulse
Description:
<font color="red">NOT IMPLEMENTED</font>

Activates Lou's link trait effect even if she is not your partner.

Name: Eating on the Road
Description:
Automatically consumes food upon starting exploration.

Allows two food item effects to stack.

Name: Zenon-Style Mobility Overdrive
Description:
<font color="red">NOT IMPLEMENTED</font>

Changes dodge effectiveness to quick.

Name: Item Use Speed Up
Description: Uses consumable items faster.
